name: Separation From God
overview: Scripture reveals that separation from God results from human sin, as all have turned away from Him and fallen short of His glory (Isaiah 53:6; Romans 3:23). This sin creates a barrier that hides God's face and prevents Him from hearing (Isaiah 59:2), though His power to save remains unhindered (Isaiah 59:1). Jesus teaches that spiritual rebirth is essential to perceive God's kingdom (John 3:3), and eternal life is granted only to those who believe in the Son, while unbelief results in remaining under God's wrath (John 3:36).
